verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm Muse maintains persistent memory across conversations (the 'Forget skill' to remove topic/person memory implies default retention, and memory data is stored/inspectable in the user's VM), plus 'side chats' exist specifically for users who want separate context, implying the main chat carries continuity across sessions by default. However there's no detailed documentation of how memory is surfaced or applied in new conversations, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming this works reliably in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification of cross-chat memory recall, detailed mechanics of context retrieval/application, and hands-on testing of memory accuracy over time.
